limits: Disposable fake SDK/temporary ledgers only; no production SQL/API/cache reads or live activation.
Page cache and reuse measured together in prior copied-ledger benchmarks, not a production throughput guarantee.
Snapshots and constructor/main-thread operations remain ephemeral; only executor writer operations reuse.
Transaction bodies are never replayed; failed cleanup poisons the writer until process restart.

source_scope: Opt-in executor-owned SQLite writer connection with16MiB page cache; default off. No changes to accounting SQL, prices, caps, uncertain holds, recovery epoch or scientific inputs.
production_activation: Requires fresh source-pinned launch after old worker exits and owner lock is free. Set OLENS_LEDGER_REUSE_WRITER_CONNECTION=1; effective mode is recorded in execution/profile metadata.
performance_limits: Offline diagnostic two-writer3.37x was a prototype; actual implementation benchmark and live judging rate remain pending.
